integrity: The claim is proved analytically from factorial word avoidance, entropy minimality, bi-balance, and the invariant Gibbs inequality. No numerical experiment or external certification is used.
scientific_limitations: Occurrences crossing the conditioning boundary are excluded; the result determines the exponential rate but not a universal prefactor, mixing law, or hitting-time limit distribution. The global SFT/Parry entropy-gap escape identity is prior work and is not claimed as new.
title: Entropy gap is the exact worst-cylinder word-avoidance exponent in entropy-minimal bi-balanced shifts
